title: The Meadow bench warms up before measuring
context: The bench app opens the Meadow at the instant the app launches, so its first case also timed Impeller OpenGL ES pipeline setup (about 570 ms on the Note10+, 515 ms on the emulator). The real app always starts on Today (lib/state/shell_navigation.dart:11), so that cost never falls inside a real Meadow opening.
options: Warm up first: open the Meadow once, unmeasured, before the 12 cases
Leave the bench as is and record the first case as a known launch cost
outcome: The owner chose the warm-up: integration_test/meadow_perf_bench_test.dart registers an unmeasured 'meadow warm-up before measuring' test before the 12 cases, whose names and 48 records stay the same.
